prompt: emacs define-modify-macro arglist disallowed parameter types
answer:
`define-modify-macro` disallows `&key` in its argument list. In Common Lisp, `&aux` and keyword arguments are not supported; only `&optional` and `&rest` are allowed. Emacs signals:

```elisp
&key not allowed in define-modify-macro
```

`&rest` can still be used to pass keyword arguments through to the function.
